status_semantics.bounded_implementation: The named bounded contract is implemented; this is not full product or human acceptance.
status_semantics.partial: Some concrete implementation exists; the remaining requirement is explicit.
status_semantics.inherited_not_reassessed: An older capability was preserved, not counted as new or fully accepted here.
status_semantics.not_implemented: No implementation of the new requirement is claimed.

evidence_rule: Use exact-SHA CI artifacts for test outcomes. Code status does not synthesize PASS, human reviews or a release claim.
